name: Applied Aerodynamics of Flight Vehicles
summary: Applies aerodynamic theory to complete vehicles: drag build-up, high-lift, transonic and supersonic configurations, and missile and launcher aerodynamics.

topics.name: Drag breakdown and component drag build-up
Airfoil and wing design for cruise
Transonic aerodynamics: supercritical airfoils, area rule, wing sweep
Supersonic configurations: slender wings, wave drag minimisation
Vortex lift and high angle-of-attack aerodynamics
Wing-body interference and engine installation effects
Aerodynamics of bodies of revolution: missiles and launch vehicles
Fin design and rocket aerodynamic coefficients (normal force, CP, damping)
Base drag and plume-induced flow effects
Aerodynamic databases from analysis, CFD and test
